info.title: Braive project API and artifact contracts
info.description: Project-owned contracts, not provider endpoints. Authenticate owner-scoped requests. Internal specialist endpoints may be functions in the same backend, not separate services. Numeric limits are configurable initial budgets. Cross-field checks are specified in development-plan.md.

200.description: Model IDs and provider request IDs

fear_description.description: The person's fear or situation, used to plan sights, sounds and events they experience. This is not a sequence of spoken navigation commands.

color_hex.description: Coordinator-chosen solid diffuse color; Wonder copies into the character node Material.color.

asset_id.description: Registered rigged character.base asset chosen by the coordinator; preserve it in the scene.

task_instruction.description: Concise context for the automatically unfolding experience; do not require the participant to narrate actions or navigate by voice.

stop_reminder.const: To stop at any time, just say STOP!

SceneRequest.description: Internal specialist artifact shape; specialists are called inside the generation job, not through a separate public HTTP endpoint.

texture_asset_id.description: Reserved legacy field; no texture assets are currently registered. New output must omit it.

collision_role.description: Mark non-solid water/decoration none; otherwise loaded geometry blocks routes.

support_node_id.description: For a grounded/mounted object, the node providing actual support.

AudioRequest.description: Internal specialist artifact shape; specialists are called inside the generation job, not through a separate public HTTP endpoint.

position.description: Reserved legacy field; current playback is non-spatial. New output must omit it.

display_title.description: [DATE] [HH:MM] - [TOPIC <=30 characters]; YYYY-MM-DD date. Disk export may sanitize colons, preserving this display title.

kind.description: Action experiences have no character dialogue. Choose conversation whenever character dialogue is needed, even briefly alongside automatic physical movement.

conversation_target.description: Approved Character.id receiving natural user speech during this step only; omit for quiet experience stages.

announce_on_entry.description: New guided scenes explicitly use false unless speech naturally belongs to the situation or supplies essential context. Legacy records retain their existing default.

footprint.description: Physical width and length in meters along the object's transformed local surface axes; position remains an unscaled local coordinate.
